name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A skill that stops your AI coding assistant from over-engineering — it writes the smallest amount of code that actually solves the problem.
buyer: A startup engineering lead tired of AI-generated code being bloated and expensive to maintain.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO installs it across the team's AI coding assistants to cut down on bloated, hard-to-maintain generated code.
A freelance developer uses it to keep client codebases lean, reducing future maintenance billing disputes.
A coding-bootcamp instructor uses it to teach minimalism by showing before/after diffs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI code hygiene audit' service that installs skills like this and cleans up a company's existing AI-bloated codebase.

steal_this: Offer a $500 'de-bloat your AI-generated codebase' audit this week, using this skill as part of the cleanup process.
